warnings: Original margins are narrower than 8% on one or more sides; all six selected sources have no alpha>16 edge contacts and no visible body/weapon truncation.
Original alpha range 0..254 and alpha1 residue retained; no threshold cleaning or forced alpha255.
Face and bust are intentional rectangular portrait windows. Ribbons, weapon tips and hat side pins may cross portrait borders. Full card preserves the full source canvas.
Candidate appearance is original illustration design, not verified historical appearance.
Six identities do not complete all official card variants or all Three Kingdoms people.
